# Every bd flag the exporter can pass, one "<subcommand> <flag>" pair per line.
# "*" means a flag passed to every subcommand (global flags appear in each
# subcommand's help). Unit tests keep this list equal to what the argv builders
# and the queue allowlist can emit; the bd flag check proves each flag exists in
# a given bd package.
* --json
* --readonly
* --sandbox
list -n
list --all
list --created-after
list --closed-after
ready -n
ready --label
ready --exclude-label
ready --exclude-type
ready --priority
ready --parent
ready --type
ready --assignee
ready --unassigned
ready --label-any
count --by-status
